Review: A short story collection by indie fantasy authors exploring grief. Personal favorites were Lullaby by K.S. Villoso, Thief by Virginia McClain, Thicker Than Water by Carol A. Park, Death in the Uncanny Valley by M.L. Wang, and Reliquary of the Damned by Rachel Emma Shaw. These had the right mix of strong character moments relating to the theme of the anthology, compelling world-building that highlights that theme, and enough of a plot to carry interest. The rest of the stories ranged from pure character reflection that might be of interest to some readers and self-indulgent plugs for the authors' main series of books in some cases.
